verdict.rationale: Chronicle is mainly an agent simulation and evaluation platform. Its only first-party claim of autonomous background operation is a one-line marketing mention of real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback. The SDK 'automate workflows' line and CI keys are developer building blocks, not configurable background automations. missing for 10: documented user-configurable automations (scheduling, triggers, background runs), detailed docs on how the autonomous monitoring/fix works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
